audience: real estate agents and developers who work with MLS listing data through SimplyRETS

useCases.title: Search MLS listings by price, beds, city and more
useCases.text: The AI searches listings by keyword, status, type, price, beds, baths, city, zip, features or a map area, and returns address, price, photos and agent.

useCases.title: Read the full details of one listing
useCases.text: The AI fetches a listing by its SimplyRETS id, with address, price, photos, agent, office, property details, school, tax and remarks.

useCases.title: Find upcoming open houses
useCases.text: The AI lists open houses with their listing, filtered by city, agent, broker, price, beds, baths or start date, and reads one open house by key.

useCases.title: Get market statistics for an area
useCases.text: The AI reads statistics for the listings a search matches, such as count, average price, bedrooms, living area and year built, and the listings per area.

useCases.title: Check the price per square foot of a listing
useCases.text: The AI reads analytics for one listing, such as its price per square foot, next to its details.

useCases.title: Look up agents and brokerage offices
useCases.text: The AI lists the agent roster and the brokerage offices of the MLS feed, with contact details and offices.
